card.name: Direction of drug interaction effects
card.fires_on: Small words like 'on' and 'of' (and sometimes a drug name) in drug interaction headings and sentences where one drug's effect on another is stated, just before the second drug is named.

modes.label: Effect of X on Y headings
modes.description: The 'of' or 'on' in interaction section titles that set up which drug acts on which.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS 7.1 Effect of ORBACTIV<< on>> CYP Substrates A screening drug

modes.label: Pharmacokinetic effect phrases
modes.description: 'on' or 'of' after pharmacokinetics or PK, before the affected drug.
modes.example: Cyclosporine alters the pharmacokinetics<< of>> aliskiren, a substrate of P

modes.label: Drug name in coadministration
modes.description: Part of a drug name inside a sentence about giving two drugs together.
modes.example: Single-dose administration of ever<<ol>>imus with either atorvastatin

card.writes: It favors words that mark reciprocal or reversed relations, like 'vice versa' and 'mutually'.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a text says which drug affects which, a two-way relationship.
